rules.statement: A subsequent suit for the same relief after proper notice to all parties is not barred under Order 23 Rule 1(3) of the Civil Procedure Code, if the first series of acts or transactions forming the basis of the first suit was incomplete and the second series is complete.
rules.supporting_quote: "So, in the present case, the reliefs claimed in both suits are the same, namely, the recovery of a sum of money due on a mortgage bond. In the Madras case the following view was taken : - ' Without attempting an exhaustive definition of all that may be included in the term ' subject-matter' it should be held that where the cause of action and the relief claimed on the second suit are not the same as the cause of action and the relief claimed in the first suit, the second suit cannot be considered to have been brought in respect of the same subject-matter as the first suit within the meaning of Order 23 Rule 1(3). '"
